name: 3 Cost Start
description: Start with a random 3-cost champion this game.

name: Silver scrapes
description: The last two surviving players gain 70 gold for an epic final fight.

name: Component + Scissors
description: After the first 3 Carousels, Gwen gifts players a random component and a pair of scissors that cut items into components.

name: Howling abyss
description: Gain 5 random 1-costs to fight on the Howling Abyss.

name: Components anvil
description: Poppy grants you two component anvils.

name: Golden Gala
description: Twisted Fate deals out all gold tier augments this game.

name: Scuttle Puddle
description: Rift Herald happily fills the game with crabs carrying bonus loot.

name: Upgraded start
description: Ekko upgrades your starting champion to 2-star.

name: Augment round swap
description: LeBlanc manipulates augments to be offered earlier this game.

name: Gold on player death
description: Whenever a player is eliminated, Draven rewards surviving players with gold per eliminated player.

name: Gold Subscription
description: Tahm Kench grants you gold each stage.

name: Loot Subscription
description: Zoe gives you highly varied loot at the start of each stage!

name: No Opening Encounter
description: It's a calm day in Runeterra. No encounter this game.

name: Augments rerolls +1
description: Teemo's scouting party has found +1 Augment reroll for all augments.

name: Prismatic Party
description: Seraphine turns all augments to prismatic tier this game.

name: Prismatic prelude
description: Galio's entrance turns the first augment to prismatic this game.

name: Prismatic finale
description: Zilean ages the last augment to perfection. It will be prismatic this game.

name: Emblem ensemble
description: Ryze grants you 3 random emblems to begin your journey.

name: 2 cost start
description: Start with a random 2-cost champion this game.
